description:
Author the approved proof sketch that factors the proof obligations for the
Charon/Aeneas-extracted loop-free generic field operations into trait-level
algebraic laws over the abstract field plus per-backend representation
refinement.

## Background

Spike `34d85cb9` established that Charon/Aeneas extraction of
`FiniteFieldExt::square` and `FiniteFieldExt::frobenius` succeeds on the
workspace MSRV toolchain with the pinned toolchain pair, and recorded the R8b
invocation that produces them together with the targets a follow-up
proof-sketch round should take (`dev/active/34d85cb9/findings.md`). Epic
`6dc81018` REQ-05, as narrowed by owner decision DEC-A, additionally requires
the proof obligations to be factored as trait-level algebraic laws plus
per-backend representation refinement, keeping machine layout out of the
mathematical specification. No other child of the epic delivers that factoring.

The repository's proof discipline requires an approved sketch — lemma
statements, proof strategy, and the exact production path — before any proof
code is written. This issue delivers that sketch. Discharging the stated lemmas
in Lean is follow-on work outside this epic.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed sketch document states, for the extracted
  `field.traits.FiniteFieldExt.square.default` and
  `field.traits.FiniteFieldExt.frobenius.default`, the trait-level algebraic
  laws they satisfy over an abstract field, written as Lean lemma statements
  that name the extracted definitions and take the `FiniteField` dictionary as
  a parameter.
- [hard] REQ-02: The sketch states the per-backend representation-refinement
  obligations in a section separate from the trait-level laws, naming each
  concrete backend it covers and the refinement relation tying that backend's
  representation to the abstract field.
- [hard] REQ-03: The sketch names the exact production path for every stated
  lemma — the Rust items, the extraction invocation that generates them, and
  the generated Lean files — and gives the proof strategy for each.
- [hard] REQ-04: The sketch records whether the extracted Lean elaborates,
  citing the exact command, its exit status, and committed output; a failure to
  elaborate is recorded as a finding rather than worked around.
title: Author the loop-free extraction proof-obligation factoring sketch
